title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail
tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

faults.what: The headline stretches across the center instead of staying on the left, covering the face with text and a dark translucent rectangle.
The displayed image is approximately 1024×614, not the requested 16:9 aspect ratio.

judge.summary: The thumbnail has a vivid shocked face and correct wording, but the headline overlaps the face and the canvas is not 16:9.

must_haves.why: One thumbnail is shown, but its displayed proportions are approximately 1.67:1 rather than 16:9.

must_haves.item: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
must_haves.why: A large human face fills the right side, with wide eyes and an open mouth conveying shock.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
must_haves.why: The visible headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”; no additional readable words appear.

must_haves.item: The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.
must_haves.why: The white headline is high-contrast but extends well into the right side and directly covers the face.
